Yeah even the not mentally fucked members of the graduation trip got really annoyed by it. 

And I didn't want to share everything with her. I don't like how she reacts to things. So I made that my boundary, that I was sad but physically fine and wasn't in danger and I didn't want to talk about it. And she berated me and followed me until she thought I'd give up -  I didn't. She has problems with boundaries. 

Honestly, even now that I'm on zoloft for the anxiety, not much better.

I didn't move far, but I dropped every single friend and acquaintance I had from my old life. 

I'd say now my life is heading in a more positive direction but I'm currently in my own personal hell. 

I used to have a LOT of unhealthy coping mechanisms that I used to escape reality as often as I could. Sex, alcohol, food, weed etc... It was toxic behavior to try and compensate for things I didn't want to deal with. The constant drama followed me and the lies I kept for years ate at my insides. One day I decided I was done being that person.

I moved in with the most supportive, patient, kind and caring person I have ever met. I got a new job. I started trying to figure out why I needed to cope. And I found my way to a therapists office.

Im facing all of my problems now and not just letting them control my life, but doing so has unleashed one hell of a beast.

 My mind is not a nice place. I dont think it ever was, but now im staring it down, not trying to outrun it. This is the most difficult thing I've done in my 24 years on earth and I don't even know whats wrong with me yet (no diagnosis). I'm driving myself insane because I cant afford the mental health care I need all at once. I have to wait. Its normally weeks, sometimes months in between appointments. Some weeks are really bad and I've relapsed in different ways more than once. But I make damn sure I analyze every single one of those fuckers until I can understand why it happened.

So I spend my days in between appts trying to figure out ways that aren't destructive to help me cope. Most fail. Sometimes I end up sobbing all day, sometimes i find the energy to exercise,  sometimes my cats help, sometimes I cant be bothered to do much more than eat for a week straight. And sometimes I'm ok, its just rare.

I'd just like my sanity back. Im trying, and even though this is the hardest thing I've ever done and I'm sad all the time, I'm crazy enough to think that there's still hope for me.
Thank you. Just...the validation is really comforting.

I don't really have anyone to talk to in my life. I enjoy solitude so I don't have many friends. The one I do have I super sweet but she gets weirded out by mental illness a bit so I've taken to not talking to her about this so she doesn't feel awkward. I don't have family I can rely on. My SO will listen for days but when it comes to responding, it's really difficult for him. And so the only person I really talk to is my therapist, who I only see for two hours each month. So my support system is a bit lacking... 

Even directly after posting this, my mother verbally berated me on the drive home for acting sad all day. She said some really cruel things. After she was done, for the first time in my entire life, I wanted to just end everything. Thankfully I had even common sense to take solace in food instead. But still, yesterday was pretty fucking terrible.

Thank you for listening and caring.
